title: Lightly Smoked Filipino Vegetables Pinakbet
description: A tangy and crispy Filipino dish featuring a variety of vegetables, perfect for a sick day. This pinakbet recipe incorporates self-raising flour and smoke-cold ingredients for an anti-inflammatory friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced eggplant, okra, string beans, and bitter melon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the self-raising flour, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the vegetable mixture and toss to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the chopped onion and minced garlic.
Cook the onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the vegetable mixture to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the fish sauce and vinegar.
Return the skillet to the stovetop and cook over low heat for an additional 5 minutes.
